title: Sepiabox asset manifest v1
description: Everything known about one photo or video, identified by the SHA-256 of its content (D-014).

id.description: SHA-256 of the file content, lowercase hex.

capturedAt.description: Wall-clock time when the photo or video was taken, without time zone (D-037); capturedAtSource says how it is known.

capturedAtSource.description: Where capturedAt came from (D-046): the file's own metadata, what an export of the photos says about it (S-045), its file name, or its parent folder's name. Optional: omitted when capturedAt is null, and absent from manifests written before S-043, whose dates all came from metadata.

sources.description: Every place where these exact bytes were found.

url.description: Optional (S-063): the original's address at its source, when the source gives one, such as a Google Photos link from a Takeout export. https only.

derivatives.description: Files generated for the web: photo thumbnails and previews (S-005), video posters and versions (S-006).

path.description: Relative to the work folder: derivatives/<id>/<name>.<extension>.

embeddings.description: Vectors by model key (S-015): base64 of float32 little-endian values. clip-vit-b32 has 512 values, L2-normalized.

caption.description: Optional (S-045, D-104): what the owner or the export's maker wrote about the photo. A merge keeps the longer caption, then the ordinally greater.

albums.description: Optional (S-045, D-104): the albums an export puts the photo in. Distinct and non-empty, in ordinal order; a merge takes the union.

quality.description: Optional (S-027, D-098): how sharp a photo is and its perceptual hash, measured from its preview. sharpness is the variance of the Laplacian of the grayscale image at 512 px (higher is sharper); dhash is the 64-bit difference hash as 16 lower-case hex characters. Absent for a video and for a photo not measured yet.

originalStored.description: Optional (S-063, D-088): false when the original stays at its source and is never uploaded (an index-only work folder). Absent means true, so manifests written before the field existed keep their meaning.

facesProcessed.description: Whether faces were looked for (process --faces, S-018). False means unknown, so faces is then empty.

facesVersion.description: Which face pipeline found the faces (D-047), bumped whenever the face models or their preprocessing change; the newer version wins a merge. Optional: only next to facesProcessed true, and absent from faces written before the field existed, which read as 1.

facesDetectedAt.description: When these faces were found (S-022, D-081), UTC. Optional: only next to facesProcessed true, and absent from faces found before the field existed, which count as found before any erase.

facesErasedAt.description: When the family last turned face recognition off (S-022, D-081), UTC: faces found at or before it are erased by every merge; faces found after it are kept. Optional; the newer one wins a merge.

faces.description: Faces found in the preview or poster (S-018), best first. Box: left, top, width and height relative to the upright derivative (0..1); map it with a derivative's width and height, never the manifest's, which describe the original as stored. Embedding: base64 of 128 float32 little-endian values (SFace), L2-normalized.
